top.en: The draft is pretty problematic. Opponent first-picks Qiyana. You pick Jarvan IV and Rumble in slots 2/3 (both are glass-cannon builds, they shatter on contact). Opponent picks Akali and Ornn in 4/5 (they hovered Olaf but didn't pick it, basically telling you they don't need to win lane, so they picked the more team-oriented Ornn). You pick Jhin in slot 7 (a champion who was doing well in the league, but who is going to deal with the Ornn in the mid-game? In teamfights, who engages faster, their Qiyana/Akali or you?). Opponent picks Corki and Nautilus (hyper-carry ADC + reliable engage). Your last pick is forced into Alistar or Poppy; Poppy prevents engages, but then you have no engage, so you have to pick Alistar. Based on this, GEN has reliable engage (Ornn ult, Nautilus Q+R) + two divers + a hyper-carry ADC. IG's engage (Jarvan IV EQ-R + Alistar WQ) has no tankiness to back it up, so they just shatter on contact. Can Jhin and Rumble even scratch an Ornn who builds early magic resist? Jhin has no mobility and will die the moment Akali or Qiyana catch him. Even if you were ahead, this comp is useless. Even if GEN were way behind, once they hit 3 items, they'd delete your 3 carries instantly.
